# AsterDrive

> Self-hosted file infrastructure in Rust for small teams: storage policies,
> reliable large-file uploads, WebDAV/WOPI, and operations visibility —
> without adopting a full private-cloud suite.

## Canonical sources

- Product overview and source: https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterDrive
- Documentation (English): https://drive.docs.astercosm.com/en/
- 中文文档: https://drive.docs.astercosm.com/
- Quick start: https://drive.docs.astercosm.com/en/start/quick-trial/
- Docker deployment: https://drive.docs.astercosm.com/en/deploy/docker/
- Storage backends: https://drive.docs.astercosm.com/en/admin/storage-backends/
- Security policy: https://github.com/AsterCommunity/AsterDrive/security

## Key facts

- Dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0
- Rust backend + React frontend, SQLite by default, PostgreSQL/MySQL optional
- Storage connectors: Local, S3-compatible, Azure Blob, Tencent COS,
  Alibaba Cloud OSS, Qiniu Kodo, OneDrive/SharePoint, SFTP, remote follower nodes
- WebDAV with RFC 3253 core DeltaV versioning; WOPI for Office editing
